name: Retailer Sale Environment 2
definition: Environment of Retailer for this message.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Default currency associated with the sale system.

MinimumAmountToDeliver.name: Minimum Amount To Deliver
MinimumAmountToDeliver.definition: Minimum amount the Sale System is allowed to deliver for this payment.

MaximumCashBackAmount.name: Maximum Cash Back Amount
MaximumCashBackAmount.definition: Maximum amount which could be requested for cash-back.

MinimumSplitAmount.name: Minimum Split Amount
MinimumSplitAmount.definition: Minimum amount to split a sale transaction.

DebitPreferredFlag.name: Debit Preferred Flag
DebitPreferredFlag.definition: Flag if preferred type of payment is a debit transaction.
